Container.Name: ARVIO-Web
Container.Overview: Preview of the independent ARVIO browser media hub, with Plex, Jellyfin and Emby support. Telegram is not available in this Unraid preview. Connect your own supported media services and sources; no ARVIO subscription is required. Built-in movie and TV metadata requires your own TMDB API v3 key. Profiles, settings and history live in each browser, not in the container. This is a browser client, not a media server, transcoder or ARVIO Cloud sync service. No media or third-party subscriptions are included. Keep this installation private; internet access requires HTTPS and authentication protecting every route.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port on your Unraid LAN. Do not forward this port to the internet; use HTTPS and an authenticated reverse proxy for remote access.

Config.Name: TMDB API v3 key
Config.Description: Your own TMDB API v3 key (32 hexadecimal characters), not the read-access bearer token. Required for built-in movie/show metadata. Kept server-side; never share this template with a saved key.

Config.Name: Allow private home-server proxy
Config.Description: Leave false unless this installation is private and authenticated. True allows server-side API requests to private Jellyfin/Plex/Emby addresses. Protect all API routes before enabling; never expose an unrestricted LAN proxy publicly.

Config.Name: Trakt application client ID
Config.Description: Optional: your own Trakt application's public client ID. Also set its server-only secret. Restart the container after changes.

Config.Name: Trakt application secret
Config.Description: Optional: your own Trakt application's secret; kept server-side. Do not enter a user access token or share filled templates.

Config.Name: SIMKL AUTH V2 client ID
Config.Description: Optional: your own SIMKL AUTH V2 public client ID for new device sign-ins and custom lists. Register a Mobile, desktop and browser app; no client secret is needed. Restart after changes.

Config.Name: SIMKL legacy V1 client ID
Config.Description: Optional: your legacy SIMKL V1 application's public client ID for existing V1 connections. New sign-ins use the separate AUTH V2 client ID. Restart after changes.

Config.Name: SIMKL legacy V1 application secret
Config.Description: Optional: your legacy SIMKL V1 application secret; kept server-side. AUTH V2 does not need it. Do not enter a user access token or share filled templates.

Config.Name: Independent resolver URL
Config.Description: Advanced and optional: HTTPS URL of your own compatible resolver, without URL credentials, query or fragment. The URL is browser-visible. Does not grant access to ARVIO-hosted services.
